prompt_ablation.finding: Generic prompt addition did not solve accuracy; candidate introduced wrong first-syllable stress and a false grammar explanation. Not promoted.

clarification_ablation.finding: The original book question and capitalized Apple admit ambiguity. Explicit noun/fruit tasks help 8B and 7B, but banana and ball errors remain; not solely a prompt issue.

context.finding: Current prompt/tool/history fit budget. Rabbit prior turn was supplied; 4B memory failure does not establish truncation or missing transport. Harness reset clears memory; server revision reset is covered by protocol tests.

mcp.finding: MCP transport succeeds, but 4B can still misread public facts. Tool route is explicit server policy.

audio.finding: TTS/Opus/Whisper proxy only; no phoneme alignment, accent/MOS assessment or real microphone/Bluetooth evidence.

conclusion: NO-GO for unsupervised education. No candidate meets the zero-critical-teaching-error gate; lexical score is not educational accuracy. Keep production unchanged and require independently reviewed curriculum/larger benchmark before promotion.
